report:
Right ovary and fallopian tube, salpingo-oophorectomy

The specimen consists of a right salpingo-oophorectomy specimen received intact (1450 g, 185 x 155 x 110 mm). The right ovary is replaced by a mass measuring 180 mm in greatest dimension (180 x 150 x 110 mm). The outer surface is smooth. Cut surface shows a multilocular cyst, mucinous contents and solid areas. The fallopian tube is unremarkable.

(1-6) Ovarian tumour, including surface.
(7) Fallopian tube, entirely embedded (SEE-FIM).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Right salpingo-oophorectomy
- Specimen integrity (right ovary): Capsule intact
- Specimen integrity (right fallopian tube): Serosa intact
- Tumour site: Right ovary
- Ovarian surface involvement: Not identified
- Fallopian tube surface involvement: Not identified
- Tumour size: 180 mm in greatest dimension (180 x 150 x 110 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Mucinous adenocarcinoma
- Histologic grade: Low grade, growth pattern-based (expansile growth or
  infiltrative growth in 10% or less)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a mucinous adenocarcinoma. The tumour is composed of intestinal-type mucinous glands showing marked architectural complexity with cribriforming, papillary infolding and solid areas, lined by stratified columnar cells with hyperchromatic pleomorphic nuclei, loss of polarity and readily identified mitotic figures. Luminal necrotic debris is conspicuous, and the carcinoma merges with adjacent benign and borderline mucinous epithelium. Invasion is expansile (confluent), with infiltrative growth in 10% or less of the tumour. Immunohistochemistry: CK7 positive, CK20 focally positive, CDX2 negative, SATB2 negative, PAX8 negative.
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- p53 immunohistochemistry: Not performed
- Largest extrapelvic peritoneal focus: Not applicable
- Peritoneal / ascitic fluid: Malignant cells not identified
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: Not submitted

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Additional findings
- None

OVARY AND FALLOPIAN TUBE, right, salpingo-oophorectomy
- MUCINOUS ADENOCARCINOMA, low grade, 180 mm, capsule intact; see synoptic
  report
